name: apex-db
description: EU and Israel vehicle specifications with per-field provenance: search variants by brand, model and model year, fetch one variant in full, and read the live coverage matrix. Keyless clients are answered from a published evaluation sample, rate-limited per IP; the full catalogue is available with a bearer token or per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: apex_search_variants
tools.description: Search vehicle variants by brand, model, model year and other filters.

tools.name: apex_get_variant
tools.description: Fetch one variant in full, including its per-field provenance.

tools.name: apex_coverage_matrix
tools.description: Read the live coverage matrix for the dataset.

tools.name: apex_lookup_by_portfolio
tools.description: Look up variants across a portfolio of brands or models.
